europe_now.title: Poland Scrambles Jets After Airspace Breach
europe_now.summary: Poland scrambled military jets after a Russian Mi-8 helicopter breached its airspace near the border with Kaliningrad. The regional security incident highlights ongoing tensions along the EU's eastern flank.

europe_now.title: Poland and Belarus Hold Foreign Minister Talks
europe_now.summary: Poland and Belarus held foreign ministerial talks for the first time in a decade, seeking a potential thaw in bilateral relations. The diplomatic engagement represents a notable shift in the neighboring states' interactions.

top_stories.title: EU Development Aid Cuts Spark Debate
top_stories.summary: A proposal within the European Union to reduce development aid funding has drawn sharp opposition from senior European Parliament figures. Critics argue that such a significant financial reduction would contradict core European values and commitments.

top_stories.title: Europol Leadership Selection
top_stories.summary: German police official Jürgen Ebner has been selected to lead Europol, taking charge of the agency's cross-border law enforcement efforts. The appointment places a seasoned national official at the helm of European police cooperation.
